keys_pickup.apartment_extra_information:
Sdam odnokomnatnuyu uyutnuyu, tepluyu, svetluyu kvartiru so svezhim dizajnerskim remontom, v samom tsentre goroda, v dvuh minutah hod'byi ot zh/d vokzala. Magazinyi, TTs, kafe, restoranyi, razvlecheniya, vsyo v shagovoj dostupnosti.
V kvartire est' vsyo neobhodimoe dlya komfortnogo prozhivaniya na korotkij i dlitel'nyij sroki. Okna kvartiryi vyihodyat vo dvor, chto obespechivaet spokojnyij otdyih. Kvartira raspolozhena na vtorom etazhe doma, chto obespechivaet gostyam legokodostupnost' s tyazhelyim bagazhom. Dannyij variant kvartiryi, vne konkurentsii). Vryad li Vyi najdyote bolee podhodyaschij variant. Esli Vam neobhodim tyoplyij, chistyij, svetlyij, tihij i uyutnyij variant kvartiryi, to Vyi obratili svoe vnimanie v vernom napravlenii). Zhdyom Vas v gosti.

Obratite vnimanie:

- Pri zaselenii, pri sebe imet' pasport.
- Gostej molozhe 21 goda ne zaselyaem.
- Kurenie, vecherinki i shumnyie meropriyatiya v kvartire, strogo ZAPRESchENYi.
Lits v netrezvom sostoyanii NE zaselyaem.

- Obyazatel'nyij zalog pri zaselenii, v razmere 3 000 r., vozvraschaetsya v den' vyiezda, pri soblyudenii vseh pravil prozhivaniya.
Ostavlyaya za soboj chistotu i poryadok, takoj zhe kak i pri zaselenii, Vyi, vyirazhaete svoe vzaimnoe uvazhenie arendodatelyu.

Sdam posutochno uyutnuyu kvartiru otvetstvennyim lyudyam slavyanskoj vneshnosti. V kvartire sdelan svezhij remont. Kvartira v tsentre goroda. V shagovoj dostupnosti ryinok, park, magazinyi, ozon, vb, tsentral'naya ploschad' goroda, stomatologicheskaya bol'nitsa, avto i zhd vokzalyi. 
- Smarttv
- Komplektyi postel'nogo bel'ya i polotenets
- Byitovaya tehnika i posuda
Zaselenie strogo po pasportu! 
Ne sdayotsya dlya prazdnikov i shumnyih vstrech! Litsam, molozhe 23 let ne bespokoit'! 
V sluchae narusheniya pravil prozhivaniya, proishodit vyiselenie bez vozvrata denezhnyih sredstv
Kurenie v kvartire zaprescheno (shtraf v razmere zaloga). 
Zaezd posle 14: 0, vyiezd do 12:00. Rannij/pozdnij zaezd/vyiezd po predvaritel'noj dogovoryonnosti. Polnaya oplata pri zaselenii. Vyihodnyie i prazdnichnyie dni tsena mozhet menyat'sya!

paragraphs: Spend an evening in a nice atmosphere of the bar. You can stop by the restaurant. Free Wi-Fi on the territory will help you to stay on-line. If you travel by car, you can park in a parking zone for free.

Also, the following services are available for guests at the hotel: a massage room, a solarium and a doctor. Guests who love doing sports will be able to enjoy a diving club. Children will be happy, there is a playroom for them. The tour assistance desk of the hotel will help you book an excursion.

If you want to make your journey even more comfortable, you can order a transfer. At the guests’ disposal, there’s also a laundry, dry cleaning, ironing, car rental, a safe-deposit box and a concierge. The staff of the hotel speaks English, Italian, German and French.
